stops.title: Mpɔtam
stops.caption: Asɔre mmaa a wɔakyekyɛ wɔ asase so.
stops.speech: Mpɔtam kyekyɛ asɔre mmaa wɔ asase so, sɛdeɛ amanneɛbɔ bɛtumi aka ɔman mu nyinaa na ɛnyɛ beaeɛ baako.

stops.title: Asɔre mmaa a ɛbata ho
stops.caption: Ɔmantam a ɛwɔ mmaa no, wɔrentumi nyi.
stops.speech: Ɔmantam biara kyerɛ asɔre mmaa a ɛbata ho. Deɛ ɛwɔ bi no, wɔrentumi nyi no kɔsɛ wɔayi baa biara afiri hɔ.
